arithmetic: Frozen deployed CPU exact integer contract; no parameter changes, training or target execution
controls: Unconditioned and conditioned on ply, side, own/opponent corner/edge/center counts. Report repeated boards in classes, class count, colliding pairs, classes differing in independent tactic tuple, and classes differing in complete optimal set. Compare logits, unmasked signs and legal mask separately.
domain: 627 previously trained/audited canonical legal nonterminal boards; 4520 unique raw boards; no new-domain generalization
examples: Per stage first lexicographic board pair in same exact class with different tactic tuple; independently first differing complete optimal-set pair. Keep first12 for diagram index, retain ALL classes/pairs metadata. No projection-as-proof.
limits: Host CPU only; no main writes, deployment edits, services, installs or publication
offline_labels: Independent geometry and minimax used only in offline census/audit
question: Which exact finite-domain representations collapse board distinctions, and which routing patterns are too coarse to identify independent tactics?
serialization: C-order shape-prefixed signed little-endian int64 for full integer stage vectors. Boolean signs as integers. SHA256 buckets plus complete byte equality checks; independent tuple-key census. routes are ordered except explicit unordered_routes. Pair+gates concatenates ordered IDs and corresponding integer gates. Executed aggregate expert stages serialize per expert ID ascending, active mask and values for active IDs only; inactive values null in records, never observations of zero. Additional per-expert applicable-population census.
warning: Cardinality/injectivity is not semantic decoding, causal use, or proof of strategic specialization. Small router cardinality is architectural and not proof of ignorance. Legal sets can differ for identical raw logits through external legal masks. Reused boards/canonical orientations are not independent observations.
